blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Former National Security Adviser Clarita Carlos has filed a cyberlibel complaint before the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) against Philippine Coast Guard spokesperson for the West Philippine Sea Rear Adm. Jay Tarriela and Philippine Military Academy Superintendent Lt. Gen. Michael Logico, NBI director Melvin Matibag confirmed. READ: Tarriela hits back at Carlos: You’re angrier at me than at China “She actually filed a complaint na cyberlibel [against] different personalities,” Matibag said. “We also entertained her.” Carlos arrived at the NBI last Friday to file the complaint.
